_about: Pierre Bayle (1647-1706): The Dictionary Historical and Critical of Mr Peter Bayle, the second edition, with the life of the author revised, corrected and enlarged by Pierre Des Maizeaux; the title page names no translator (London: J. J. and P. Knapton and others, 1734-1738, 5 vols.), raw IA OCR, clean 0.81-0.88. The OCR shows the imprint year on vol. II (MDCCXXXV) and, garbled, on vols. IV and V (MDCCXXXVII, MDCCXXXVIII); on vols. I and III it is not legible, and 1734 and 1736 are inferred from the run and the catalogue. Vol. I's text layer is about a quarter the length of the others, so much of its small-type commentary is probably missing from the OCR. US public domain. No uids minted.
